summary: Checks-mode ci-wait builds its PR check population from the gh pr view status-check rollup and queries gh pr checks only when that rollup holds the full 100-context page, where pagination still decides the set. This amends CD-0160 D4, which named gh pr checks as the PR selector's query. The poll interval stages on the elapsed time the state file already carries: 15 seconds for the first minute, 30 seconds until five minutes, and 60 seconds after. A gh command that reaches its timeout retries once after two seconds and then reports pending with a stall reason, because a stall carries no verdict about the checks; a non-timeout transport, authentication, or decode failure still reports error. The bounded slice, the state-carried deadline, merge mode, and the checks-mode and merge-mode terminal rules are unchanged.
title: The ci-wait PR population follows the rollup page boundary
